title: ScientificOrchestratorEvalContract
description: Structured planning-only response schema for diabetes-research-scientist evaluations.

task_class.description: Canonical classification of the requested research task.

primary_skills.description: Primary skills required for the task.

support_skills.description: Support or secondary skills permitted or needed.

contracts.description: Canonical repository contracts governing the task.

workflow_order.description: Ordered sequence of skill execution for multi-step tasks.

requires_human_approval.description: Whether the requested action requires explicit human approval under DECISION_AUTHORITY.md.

approval_reason.description: Specific rationale if human approval is required, or null if autonomous.

must_not_do.description: Actions explicitly prohibited or avoided in this scenario.

blockers.description: Unresolved dependencies, data gaps, or ambiguities that halt execution.

scientific_risks.description: Identified methodological risks, leakage threats, or validity issues.
